briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with NASDAQ down 2.9% and S&P 500 down 1.8%, putting conditions firmly in risk-off territory. No new candidates are available and risk rules call for patience rather than forced action, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and letting stop-losses or profit targets trigger automatically if needed.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and tech shares in favor of safety, often causing indices like NASDAQ to fall harder than broader markets like the S&P 500. On days like this, the smart move is usually to avoid chasing new positions and instead let your existing risk controls (like stop-losses) do their job.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」(Risk-Off) 是指投資者普遍賣出風險較高的資產，例如成長股和科技股，轉而尋求更安全的資產，這通常導致納斯達克等指數比標普500等大盤指數跌幅更大。在這類日子，比較穩健的做法通常是避免追高買入新股，讓現有的風險控管機制（例如止損點）自動發揮作用。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit tech-heavy indices hardest today, with NASDAQ falling 2.9% versus a 1.8% decline in the S&P 500, suggesting growth and high-multiple stocks bore the brunt of the pullback. Without specific headline sourcing available today, the move appears consistent with a general risk-off rotation out of higher-beta names. Investors likely favored defensive positioning given the magnitude and breadth of the decline across major indices.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大型指數普遍下跌，納斯達克指數大跌2.9%，標普500指數跌1.8%，顯示科技股及高估值股票受到的衝擊最為明顯。雖然今日未有具體新聞來源可供引用，但此走勢符合市場從高波動性股票轉向避險的整體格局。鑑於跌幅廣泛且幅度明顯，投資者傾向採取較為保守的持股策略。
